title: Metal Gear Alert (!)
blurb: Two notes and an exclamation mark, and Solid Snake's entire evening is ruined. Konami's 1998 alert sting is one of the most efficient pieces of storytelling in games: a guard's head turns, the symbol appears, and the music changes before you have finished processing what went wrong. It is the definitive being-noticed sound. Play it when somebody catches you mid-snack at three in the morning, when a manager walks behind your screen, or when eye contact occurs at the worst conceivable moment. Stealth failed. Alert phase initiated.
origin: The guard-alert '!' sting from Metal Gear Solid (Konami).
